## Problem

The problem or need this addresses. What are you trying to do and why.

## Proposed Solution

What you would like to happen. Be concrete where you can.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you did not choose them.

## Scope and Impact

Which repository or product this affects, and any cross-repo impact.

## Additional Context

Links, references, or prior discussion.
